content:
The latest iOS WhatsApp beta introduces several redesigned chat room customization options, including dynamic wallpapers. Here are the details.

The animation effects are reportedly quite detailed.

According to WABetaInfo, the latest WhatsApp version on TestFlight includes what they had previously found in the recent Android WhatsApp beta: a brand-new series of chat room themes, divided into three categories: "Featured," "Doodle," and "Minimalist."

According to reports, "Doodle" will offer wallpapers inspired by WhatsApp's classic doodle patterns, while "Minimalist" will use pure white or pure black backgrounds depending on light or dark mode. As for "Featured," wallpapers with detailed dynamic effects will be added.

WABetaInfo content as follows:

The site also points out that the color of chat bubbles will change according to the wallpaper, automatically matched by WhatsApp rather than customized separately by users.

WABetaInfo says this feature is still in development, and no test users can try it out for the time being. However, since WhatsApp is now developing simultaneously on both iOS and Android, it is believed that some test users will soon get an early look, and the official launch should not be far off.
